subject: Re: Kickoff: MobileBERT on-device NLU — decisions before the July sweep
body:
Team,

Decisions locked before next week's sweep:

1) We go with option (b): quantization-aware fine-tuning is in scope for the July run on Vulcan, with Vera owning the grid. Amara's option (a) float16 fallback is the contingency if QAT doesn't close the 1.9-point F1 gap — Milan, please have the capability check for the fallback path ready either way.
2) The 250 ms latency budget stands. If the two cheapest devices can't hit it post-QAT, they route to Milan's server fallback rather than degrading the on-device bar.
3) Launch-review packet moves from Jul 20 to Jul 17 at Nadia's request — LRB calendar is packed that week, and sign-off is required before the device team's external demo.

Efe — please pre-register the eval plan for the sweep so we're not arguing metrics after the fact.

Thanks,
Priya
